description: Token-efficient Discogs CLI for AI agents (PyPI package agent-discogs): searches the Discogs music database and shows releases, masters, artists, labels, tracklists, credits and price suggestions as compact text or JSON.
rules: This is jmfontaine/agent-discogs, a command-line tool (PyPI package agent-discogs). It is not the discogs-sdk Python library or any other Discogs client.
Install it with `pipx install agent-discogs` or `uv tool install agent-discogs`, and authenticate by setting the DISCOGS_TOKEN environment variable to a Discogs personal access token.

Run `agent-discogs skills get core` (add `--full` for its references) and read it before relying on these pages: it is the authoritative guide for the installed version, while these pages describe the latest main branch.
Pass the refs printed in the output (@r… release, @m… master, @a… artist, @l… label) back into later commands, such as `agent-discogs get release @r…`.
Prefer `--json` (on search, get, tracks, price and cache clear) when parsing the output: the text output is meant for reading.
